payload.summary: New physical Win7 evidence refines the crash boundary: Settings and Cantiere can be entered and remain usable; the application crashes when entering Assistente. All diagnostic probes whose labels begin with 0 produce no visible failure, while probes 1 and 2 crash. This points to Assistente/model-load or update initialization rather than generic navigation, Flutter interaction, or whole-app shell.
decisions: Treat Settings and Cantiere navigation as physically safe in this candidate.
Focus the bounded claim on Assistente initialization and the model/update chain it starts.
Do not merge from CI alone and do not change Win8.1/10/11 behavior.
evidence_refs: physical:0-series probes no visible failure; probes 1 and 2 crash
payload.next_action: Inspect PR #736 Assistente entry path and split the first Assistente/model-load initialization stages into one narrower Win7 diagnostic candidate.
